tools.name: bitbucket_pulls
tools.description: Pull requests in a Bitbucket repository, most recently updated first, with their state, branches and reviewers. Get the workspace and repository from the git remote.

state.description: Default open. closed covers merged, declined and superseded.

tools.name: bitbucket_pull_files
tools.description: Every file a Bitbucket pull request touches, with its unified diff. Use it to review a change without checking it out.

tools.name: bitbucket_comments
tools.description: What people wrote on a Bitbucket pull request, oldest first.

tools.name: bitbucket_pipelines
tools.description: Recent Bitbucket Pipelines runs for a repository, newest first, with status and conclusion. Narrow by branch, status or commit.

status.description: Only pipelines in this state, or with this conclusion.

tools.name: bitbucket_pipeline
tools.description: One Bitbucket pipeline with each of its steps and their status, which is how to see which step failed.

runId.description: The pipeline's id, the {uuid} from bitbucket_pipelines.

tools.name: bitbucket_step_log
tools.description: The end of one pipeline step's log, line by line. Use it to read why a step failed: start with the default tail, or grep for the error. truncated means earlier lines were left out.

jobId.description: The step's id from bitbucket_pipeline, which names the pipeline and the step.

tail.description: How many lines from the end to return, after any grep. Default 200.

grep.description: Only lines containing this text, ignoring case.
